words.example: We go to school by car.

words.definition: a big vehicle that carries many people

words.definition: a long vehicle that runs on metal tracks
words.example: The train leaves the station at nine o'clock.

words.definition: a vehicle that flies in the sky
words.example: We travel by plane to visit family.

words.definition: a vehicle with two wheels that you ride using your legs
words.example: I ride my bike to school.

words.definition: a car that takes people somewhere for money
words.example: We took a taxi to the airport.

words.definition: a small vehicle that travels on water
words.example: They cross the river by boat.

words.definition: a large boat that carries people or goods across the sea
words.example: The ship sails across the ocean.

words.definition: to move by putting one foot in front of the other
words.example: I walk to the shop every day.

words.definition: to control a car and make it move
words.example: My father drives to work.

words.definition: to travel on a bike, a horse, or in a vehicle

words.definition: a small piece of paper that lets you travel or enter a place

words.definition: a place where trains or buses stop for passengers

words.definition: a place where planes take off and land

words.definition: a hard surface that cars and other vehicles drive on

words.definition: the cars and other vehicles moving on a road

words.definition: to not move anymore

words.definition: to go from one place to another
words.example: I like to travel to new countries.

words.definition: to reach a place

words.definition: not fast, moving with little speed
words.example: The bus is very slow today.

text: Every day, people travel in different ways. Some people walk to work, and some ride a bike. My father drives his car to the office, but there is often a lot of traffic on the road. My mother takes the bus because it stops near our house. Yesterday, I went to the train station to buy a ticket because I wanted to visit my aunt in another city. The train was a little slow, but I arrived safely. Next month, my family will travel by plane, so we will go to the airport early. My brother loves boats and ships. He wants to be a sailor and travel on a big ship one day. Sometimes, when we don't have a car, we call a taxi. There are many ways to travel: by car, bus, train, plane, bike, boat, or taxi. I think riding a bike is the best way because it is healthy and fun.
